items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: David Jones, he formed the band.

ctx.x: That was the reading band, too?

Oh, yeah, yeah. It's a reading. Mm-hmm. It's a rehearsal, by Willie Foster's house. It was my mama's niece. Well, I played there with them. Let me see where I played there with them. Well, they chose the giant gun on the counter, dope and so forth, you know. And when I was holding, I was in the bucket. Well, I quit the job. I quit the job myself. But they told me they read the place one night, and I quit. The fact that all of us picked up the code to pay the job. And I left there, and I goes to the Pete Lauer.…
